# astcenc

ARM [astc-encoder](https://github.com/ARM-software/astc-encoder) core library sources (no CLI), used by `dm/gfx/tex/nvn_astcenc.cpp` to transcode Switch BC textures to ASTC on GPUs without BC (A16 fork).

- Version: 5.2.0 (upstream tag `5.2.0`)
- License: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`)
- Unmodified library sources from `Source/` (CLI omitted)
